en: Kusala-ttika, Dassana-ttikādi (The Triplet of the Wholesome, the Triplet of Seeing, etc.)
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and not to be abandoned by vision … pe … dependent on a state that is unwholesome and not to be abandoned by cultivation … (Abbreviated.
Under root: twenty-nine; under object: twenty-four … pe … under result:

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor to be abandoned by vision or by cultivation … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has a root to be abandoned by vision … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has a root to be abandoned by cultivation … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four.
... pe ... nine in the case of resultants ... pe ... twenty-nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not unwholesome, whose roots are to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation ... dependent on a state that is not unwholesome and does not lead to accumulation ...
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are twenty-one; under object-condition, seventeen ... pe ... nine in the case of resultants ... pe ... twenty-one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor leading to diminution … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor leading to neither-accumulation-nor-diminution … (In all cases, seventeen. There is no result.)

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor pertaining to the higher training (*na-kusala-na-sekkha*) … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor pertaining to the higher training … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition (*hetu*), twenty-nine; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four … [and so on] … under the resultant condition (*vipāka*), nine … [and so on] … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor neither-pertaining-nor-not-pertaining-to-the-higher-training (*na-kusala-na-neva-sekkha-nāsekkha*) … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, seventeen … [and so on] … under the repetition condition (*āsevana*), nine … [and so on] … under the resultant condition, nine … [and so on] … under the non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor limited (*na-kusala-na-paritta*) … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition (*hetu*), seventeen; … pe … under result-condition (*vipāka*), nine; … pe … under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*), seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor sublime (*na-kusala-na-mahaggata*) … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor immeasurable (*na-kusala-na-appamāṇa*) … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, twenty-nine; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four; … pe … under result-condition, nine; … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has a limited object … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has a lofty object … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor has an immeasurable object … (Abbreviated.
Under root: twenty-nine; under object: twenty-four … pe … under result: nine … pe … under non-disappearance: twenty-nine.
